text: A plumbing build's agent works on a copy of the repository outside the home directory, for D-0105, with no shell and one tool. The tool runs gofmt on the files the change touches, go vet, every test and the acceptance tests, in the pinned Go image, with no network and this machine's module cache read-only. The tool and the factory's own final run take the plan and its tests from the factory's checkout, not the agent's copy, and only the files the plan names come back. A second agent, which can only read, reviews the change against the plan, and the factory merges only when the review approves it.
